name: Miller's Law
axiom: Working memory capacity spans approximately seven, plus or minus two, discrete information chunks.
trigger: Users lose track of values across long unbroken strings, forms, or dashboards with many competing figures.
checklist: Chunk long strings: format card numbers as four groups of four digits.
Split multi-step checkout into three to five navigable phases.
Cap visible summary cards on an overview dashboard at seven key indicators.

antiPattern.violation: A payment field demands a raw 16-digit card number in one unformatted text string.
antiPattern.remediation: Parse input into visible groups as typed (4111 0000 0000 1111) so it can be verified quickly.

academicOrigin.title: The Magical Number Seven, Plus or Minus Two: Some Limits on Our Capacity for Processing Information
